frozen_gate_logic_audit.interpretation: The frozen analyzer treats integer zero support violations as false inside all(completeness_safety.values()). The independent audit recomputes the intended condition as support_violations == 0 without modifying the frozen analyzer.

within_epoch_clip_dynamics.interpretation_boundary: This descriptive diagnostic distinguishes initial old-policy reconstruction from drift after within-epoch optimizer updates; it is not an additional preregistered promotion gate.
within_epoch_clip_dynamics.clip_fraction_semantics: sequence_ratio_clip_fraction is the fraction of state-action sequence ratios outside [0.8, 1.2]. It is a two-sided, sequence-level diagnostic, not a token-drop rate and not the fraction of examples with zero total gradient. PPO actor-branch saturation additionally depends on the advantage sign. The audit reports that plateau fraction separately, as well as ratios outside the band that retain a corrective Actor gradient; Value and KL terms can still contribute gradients in either case.

manual_gate.rationale: Within each search family, the four estimators are compute-matched: candidate-token ratios to E0 span 0.9881–1.0107, candidate-forward ratios span 0.9956–1.0121, and summed invocation-time ratios span 0.9544–0.9996. The independent audit also reconstructs one successful GPU1 session totaling 108.586 reserved hours. This PASS supports only the fairness and credibility of within-family estimator comparisons; it does not override the failed stability or positive-transfer gates, does not equate the deliberately different search-family budgets, and does not establish a winning estimator.

elapsed_time_caveat: Per-summary elapsed_seconds is invocation-local. The run-session/GPU audit is authoritative for total reserved GPU-hours. Multiple run sessions mean at least one runner-level resume occurred and artifact elapsed time must not be represented as exact end-to-end wall time.
